# `core/AppBootstrap.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/AppBootstrap.js`

AppBootstrap.js - Application bootstrap helper Consolidates common app initialization: WebGPU check, canvas ready, config loading, ECS world, GPU init, and main loop setup.

## Functions

### `async bootstrapApp(options)`

Bootstrap a complete application.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Bootstrap options
- `options.canvas` *(HTMLCanvasElement)* — Canvas element
- `options.gpu` *(Object)* — GPU state object
- `options.ecs` *(Object)* — ECS state object
- `options.config` *(Object)* — Config state object
- `options.physics` *(Object)* — Physics state object
- `options.render` *(Object)* — Render state object
- `options.worldName` *(string)* — World name (default: "AppWorld")
- `options.configUrl` *(string)* — Config file URL (default: "./engine.cfg")
- `options.applyConfig` *(Function)* — Function to apply config overrides
- `options.logger` *(Function)* — Logger

**Returns:** { device, world } or throws on failure

### `createMainLoop(options)`

Create main loop with standard update/render pattern.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — Loop options
- `options.ecs` *(Object)* — ECS state
- `options.stepWorld` *(Function)* — World step function
- `options.stepWorldFrame` *(Function)* — World frame step function
- `options.syncInput` *(Function)* — Input sync function
- `options.updateCamera` *(Function)* — Camera update function
- `options.updateGrab` *(Function)* — Grab update function
- `options.stepSimulations` *(Function)* — Simulations step function
- `options.drawScene` *(Function)* — Scene draw function
- `options.createTestLoop` *(Function)* — Loop creator function
- `options.render` *(Object)* — Render state for FPS tracking
- `options.logger` *(Function)* — Logger

### `async runApp(options)`

Full app bootstrap + loop in one call.

**Parameters:**

- `options` *(Object)* — All options combined

**Returns:** { device, world, loop }
